## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r}
library(Seurat) 
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(writexl)

#Read the data
data <- readRDS("/path_to_folder/HarmonyIntegrated_annotated_data_final.rds")

data$CellTypes <- Idents(data)
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r, echo=TRUE}
p1 <- DimPlot(data,
              reduction = "umap",
              label = TRUE,
              label.size = 5, pt.size = 0.5, repel = TRUE
) + NoLegend()

# Make the fonts Bold

p2 <- p1 + theme(
  text = element_text(face = "bold"),
  legend.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
  axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
  axis.text = element_text(face = "bold")
)

print(p2)

# Plot the UMAP of before and after to compare
Plot1 <- DimPlot(data, split.by = "orig.ident",
                reduction = "umap",
                label = FALSE,
                label.size = 5, pt.size = 0.5, repel = TRUE
) + NoLegend()

print(Plot1)


Plot2 <- DimPlot(data,
                reduction = "umap",
                label = TRUE,
                label.size = 5, pt.size = 0.5, repel = TRUE
)

print(Plot2)

Plot3 <- DimPlot(data,
                reduction = "umap", pt.size = 0.8,
                label = FALSE,
)  + NoLegend()

print(Plot3)


```
